title: GPU-Aware Embeddings for R
text: cudaembedr embedding layer cudaverse. gives UMAP, t-SNE, diffusion-map-style embeddings common result structure accepts matrices, cuda_pca results, cudatensor objects, cudacell_workflow results.

title: GPU-Aware Embeddings for R
text: UMAP: uwot CPU; t-SNE: Rtsne CPU; diffusion map: CUDA-aware pairwise distances cudalearnr, followed CPU kernel construction eigendecomposition. result reports source_device, compute_device, backend. Diffusion-map results also report compute_stages, separating distance, kernel, eigendecomposition provenance. CUDA distance followed CPU kernel/eigendecomposition therefore reported compute_device = "hybrid", never entirely GPU-native workflow.

title: GPU-Aware Embeddings for R
text: diffusion-map implementation works base eigensolver uses RSpectra automatically installed. UMAP t-SNE optional adapters: Installing packages make UMAP t-SNE GPU-native; current backends remain CPU implementations listed .

title: GPU-Aware Embeddings for R
text: See cudaverse end--end workflow complete sparse-counts--embedding example. installation, device verification, hybrid-stage interpretation, common failures, see cudaverse GPU setup troubleshooting guide.
code: library(cudalearnr) library(cudaembedr)  pca <- cuda_pca(matrix(rnorm(1000), 100, 10), n_components = 5) embedding <- cuda_diffusion_map(pca, n_components = 2)  embedding embedding_coordinates(embedding)

title: Diffusion-map-style embedding — cuda_diffusion_map
text: Pairwise distances can use cudalearnr CUDA path. Kernel construction eigendecomposition currently run CPU.

title: Diffusion-map-style embedding — cuda_diffusion_map
code: cuda_diffusion_map(   x,   n_components = 2L,   sigma = NULL,   diffusion_time = 1,   metric = c("euclidean", "cosine"),   device = c("auto", "cuda", "cpu") )

title: Diffusion-map-style embedding — cuda_diffusion_map
text: x Numeric observation--feature matrix compatible cudaverse result. n_components Output dimensions. sigma Gaussian kernel bandwidth. Defaults median positive pairwise distance. diffusion_time Non-negative diffusion time exponent. metric Euclidean cosine distance. device Device passed cudalearnr::cuda_distance().

title: Diffusion-map-style embedding — cuda_diffusion_map
text: cuda_embedding stable fields documented cuda_umap(), stage-level distance/kernel/eigendecomposition provenance, additional eigenvalues element.
